en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a street scene with historic buildings. The street is identified as 'Schulstrasse' in Bad Pyrmont. There are people in early 20th-century attire walking and standing along the street. On the back, there is handwritten German text, a green Deutsches Reich postage stamp, and postmarks from the early 1900s. There is also blue ink from the Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.
